name: Banners
description: Shows a banner image at the top of a note, from the same frontmatter property your Obsidian banner plugin uses.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Banner properties
settings.description: Frontmatter properties to read the banner image from, comma-separated. The first one a note has is used. "banner" is used by Banners, Banners Reloaded, Pixel Banner and Pretty Properties; "banner_image" and "backdrop" by Banner Images; "art" by Note Banners.

settings.name: Height
settings.description: Banner height in pixels. Narrow screens get a shorter banner.

settings.name: Fade into page
settings.description: Fade the bottom of the banner into the page background.

settings.name: Show on home page
settings.description: Also show a banner on the home page when it has one.
